summary:
Comprehensive 13-point architectural and UI/UX modernization plan for Telenotes:
- Complete removal of To-dos across the entire codebase.
- Native full-screen responsive viewport adapting to device status bar and gestures without artificial gaps.
- Dual landing page mode (Diary vs Books) with prominent top switch in sliding Hamburger navigation sidebar.
- Common top bar across modes (Telenotes title, Search, Lock, Hamburger trigger).
- Sliding Hamburger Settings drawer with rich theme presets, custom colors, auto-backup intervals, and updated master key security UI.
- Diary Feed enhancements: optional tags, customizable snippets, long-press contextual menus with universal click-outside dismissal.
- Books Homepage: 2x2 grid with compact vintage leather covers and long-press action sheets.
- Rich Diary Canvas: floating text-selection toolbar, category-based docked formatting bar (bottom/top selectable), bilingual typography (English + Hindi Devanagari fonts), transparent resizable stickers & GIFs, draggable media with display modes, and custom background image with opacity slider.
- Books Studio Canvas: inherited rich text suite + dedicated Chapters drawer with word goals and status tracking.
